name: unchained_berserker_damage_from_white_sources_is_prevented_other_damage_is_not
notes: Printed: 'Protection from white (This creature can't be ... dealt damage ... by anything white.)'. A white 9/9 deals 5 to the Berserker: prevented, nothing is dealt. A green 9/9 deals 1: it is dealt, and kills the 1/1. Only the green damage is on record.
